features.title: Studio, now in Framework
features.description: Build complete apps and custom pages without code. Studio now ships with the Framework, works with AI agents, and your interfaces go live as soon as you save them.

features.title: A new way to print reports
features.description: Pick a print format, letterhead and page settings, and see a live preview update as you go.

features.title: Upload first, fill in later
features.description: Start a document by uploading its file, then complete the form. Turn it on for any DocType.

features.title: Import rows into child tables
features.description: Bring rows into a child table from Excel and map each column to a field, the same way the data import works.

features.title: Web Forms, rebuilt
features.description: Arrange fields with a drag-and-drop editor, pull fields in from the DocType, and share forms through private links.
